slug: 天神传说第438章改革开始
content_zh:
一个半月后。
落日山脉。
“大伯，还有多久啊。”
苏少卿一脸疲惫地靠在树上，眼巴巴的看着苏鸿成。
“快了，快了。”苏鸿成在前方走着。
半个月前，三人进入了落日山脉，这里的路马匹已是无法行走，三人只能下马步行，苏鸿成和苏鸿章倒是驾轻就熟，只是苦了苏少卿这细皮嫩肉，哪能受了这苦。
“大哥，要不让少卿休息会吧，他第一次走这远路，多体谅一下吧。”苏鸿章道。
“好吧。”苏鸿成停下脚步，转过身，看着二人。
“那有个山洞，我们去那吧。”苏鸿成指了指旁边的洞。
“好。”苏鸿章点了点头。
“我这是怎么了，就算多年不出门经商，这体力也不能下降成这样吧。”苏鸿章有些微喘道。
“爹，怎么了。”苏少卿扶住苏鸿章。
“没事，人老了，体力跟不上了。”苏鸿章摇了摇头。
“爹，您还没大伯年龄大呢，怎么就老了。”苏少卿道。
“呵呵，也是啊。”苏鸿章笑了笑。
“快过来，这个洞还挺干净的。”
苏鸿成站在洞口，对二人喊道。
“来了大伯。”苏少卿起身喊道。
“爹，走吧，我扶着你。”
“嗯，好。”

苏鸿章在苏少卿的搀扶下，一步一步走向山洞。
“一个半月了，这都快到玄天门了，应该，没事了吧。”苏鸿章内心突然想起来苏磊的告诫，不由得看了看旁边的苏鸿成。
“怎么了，二弟。”苏鸿成见他看自己，笑了笑。
“没事，大哥又帅了几分。”苏鸿章回道。
“要帅谁能帅过你，我这么多年雨打风霜的，一脸的老皮，哪里有你这风范。”苏鸿成一边塔烤架一边打趣道。
“大哥为了家辛勤付出，全家人看在眼里，这可远比我帅多了。”苏鸿章道。
“不愧是兄弟，这么多年的付出，好歹有人能看见，就你这一句，我值了。”苏鸿成塔建起了烤架，从玄戒中取出半扇前几天吃剩下的猪肉，烤了起来。
“你们两个就别谦虚了，大伯你快点烤，我都饿了，爹，你可别打扰我大伯烤肉了。”苏少卿此刻就是一个吃货，满眼就全是那半扇猪肉。
“好好好。”苏鸿成笑着点了点头。
“你这孩子。”苏鸿章无奈的摇了摇头。
“孩子吗，长身体，容易饿，理解理解，没事。”苏鸿成道。
“在家何倩就宠着，在外面，也该让他吃点苦了，不然将来怎么处事啊。”苏鸿章道。
“将来的事，将来再说，玄天门难道还有人敢欺负少卿不成。”苏鸿成笑着。
“就是就是，我可是比武大会第一，有人欺负我，打回去不就行了。”苏少卿一脸骄傲道。
“你呀，天赋好是好事，但也要磨练心性，戒……”
“戒骄戒躁，待人平和，不要有优越感，要公平，要讲理，爹，这话你都说了一路了，你说的痛快，我耳朵都要长茧了。”苏少卿一脸嫌弃道。
“你小子，长本事了啊，敢顶嘴了啊，你看我怎么收拾你。”苏鸿章一把撸起袖子，作势要打。
“啊，大伯救命啊，我爹他谋杀亲儿了，”苏少卿鬼哭狼嚎的躲在苏鸿成身后。
“大哥，你让开。”
“哈哈哈，鸿章，少卿还小，放了他吧。”苏鸿成道。

苏鸿章把袖子放下，坐了下来。
“大哥，也就你宠他了。”苏鸿章瞪了眼苏少卿。
苏少卿调皮的对苏鸿章吐了吐舌头。
“少卿，坐下，安分点，你爹本来身体就不适，别惹他了。”苏鸿成道。
“哦，好。”苏少卿笑了笑，坐了下来。
content_en:
A month and a half later.
Sunset mountains.
"Uncle, how long does it take?"
Su Shaoqing leaned against the tree with a tired look on his face, looking at Su Hongcheng eagerly.
"Come on, come on." Su Hongcheng walked ahead.
Half a month ago, the three of them entered the Sunset Mountains. The horses could no longer walk on the road here, so the three of them could only dismount and walk. Su Hongcheng and Su Hongzhang were quite familiar with it, but Su Shaoqing's thin skin and tender flesh could not bear this suffering.
"Brother, why don't you let Shaoqing rest for a while? It's his first time walking such a long distance. Please be more considerate." Su Hongzhang said.
"Okay." Su Hongcheng stopped, turned around, and looked at the two of them.
"There is a cave there, let's go there." Su Hongcheng pointed to the cave next to him.
"Okay." Su Hongzhang nodded.
"What's wrong with me? Even if I haven't gone out to do business for many years, my physical strength cannot be reduced to this." Su Hongzhang gasped slightly.
"Dad, what's wrong?" Su Shaoqing supported Su Hongzhang.
"It's okay. As we get older, our physical strength can no longer keep up." Su Hongzhang shook his head.
"Dad, you are not older than your uncle, why are you old?" Su Shaoqing said.
"Haha, that's right." Su Hongzhang smiled.
"Come here quickly, this hole is quite clean."
Su Hongcheng stood at the entrance of the cave and shouted to the two of them.
"Uncle is here." Su Shaoqing stood up and shouted.
"Dad, let's go, I'll help you."
"Yeah, okay."
With the support of Su Shaoqing, Su Hongzhang walked towards the cave step by step.
"It's been a month and a half. We're almost at Xuantianmen. It should be okay." Su Hongzhang suddenly remembered Su Lei's warning and couldn't help but look at Su Hongcheng next to him.
"What's wrong, second brother?" Su Hongcheng saw him looking at him and smiled.
"It's okay, big brother is a bit more handsome." Su Hongzhang replied.
"Who can be more handsome than you? I have been weathered for so many years and I have an old-fashioned face. How can I have your demeanor?" Su Hongcheng joked while standing on the grill.
"My eldest brother works hard for the family, and the whole family sees it. He is much more handsome than me." Su Hongzhang said.
"As expected of a brother, after so many years of hard work, at least someone can see it. Just your word, I'm worth it." Su Hongchengta built a grill, took out half of the leftover pork from the Xuan Ring, and grilled it.
"You two, stop being modest. Uncle, hurry up and grill. I'm already hungry. Dad, don't disturb my uncle while he's grilling." Su Shaoqing was a foodie at the moment, and all he could see was the half fan of pork.
"Okay, okay." Su Hongcheng smiled and nodded.
"You kid." Su Hongzhang shook his head helplessly.
"Are you a kid? He's getting hungry easily because of his long body. I understand. It's okay." Su Hongcheng said.
"He Qian is pampering him at home, but outside, it's time to let him suffer a little, otherwise how will he deal with things in the future." Su Hongzhang said.
"Let's talk about the future in the future. Is there anyone in Xuantianmen who dares to bully Shaoqing?" Su Hongcheng smiled.
"That's right, I'm the first in the martial arts competition. If someone bullies me, just fight back." Su Shaoqing said with a proud face.
"You, it's a good thing to have good talent, but you also need to hone your character and be careful..."
"Beware of arrogance and impetuosity, treat others peacefully, don't have a sense of superiority, be fair, and be reasonable. Dad, you've been saying this all the time. You said it so happily that my ears almost have calluses." Su Shaoqing said with a look of disgust.
"You kid, you have grown up, you dare to talk back, you see how I deal with you." Su Hongzhang rolled up his sleeves, preparing to beat him.
"Ah, uncle, help me, my father murdered his own son," Su Shaoqing wailed and hid behind Su Hongcheng.
"Brother, get out of the way."
"Hahaha, Hongzhang, Shaoqing is still young, let him go." Su Hongcheng said.
Su Hongzhang put down his sleeves and sat down.
"Brother, you are the only one who loves him." Su Hongzhang glared at Su Shaoqing.
Su Shaoqing naughtily vomited at Su HongzhangTongue.
"Shaoqing, sit down and be calm. Your father is not feeling well. Don't mess with him." Su Hongcheng said.
"Oh, okay." Su Shaoqing smiled and sat down.
